items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution for new launches, experiments, monetization changes, and spend; retain only the existing period-aligned finance reconciliation. Amazon reports $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21 from 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items, but all commission is unattributed. AI usage costs are $922.381 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28 across 5,048 calls, including 229 errors. Contribution margin, cost-to-learn, AI payback, infrastructure burden, budget capacity, and forecasts are not calculable because revenue and AI costs cover different periods and matching-period infrastructure, labor, operating costs, commitments, budget ceilings, and learning thresholds are absent. Do not treat missing values as zero. SEO totals, improvement counts, and the 3 proven outcomes are operating or delivery metrics, not financial proof. Continue existing reconciliation only and reject unsupported revenue, margin, ROI, payback, forecast, and causal-lift claims.

CFO review: defer the three CRO opportunities for financial gating. Feasibility, popularity, clicks, impressions, sessions, and proposed time-to-learn windows do not establish contribution margin or payback. Reconsider only after the existing reconciliation produces period-aligned revenue and cost evidence, with an explicit learning threshold and rollback-controlled measurement plan.
